title: National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting Amendment (Timely Publication of Emissions) Bill 2018
short_title: National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting Amendment (Timely Publication of Emissions) Bill 2018

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would force the government to publish quarterly greenhouse gas emissions data on time after past delays.
The department secretary must give the minister a report within 5 months of each quarter's end, and the minister must table it in Parliament within 15 sitting days before it goes online.
Each report must cover national emissions for the quarter and the year to date, broken down by sector, and follow international guidelines like those from the IPCC.
changes: Requires the secretary to prepare quarterly emissions estimates reports within 5 months.
Requires the minister to table each report in Parliament within 15 sitting days.
Requires each report to include quarterly and annual national emissions figures, with sector breakdowns.
Requires reports to follow IPCC or replacement international guidelines.
summary.affected: The Department of the Environment and Energy, the minister, and the public who access emissions data.

speeches.speaker: Cathy McGowan
speeches.brief: The speaker seconded the motion for the National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting Amendment (Timely Publication of Emissions) Bill 2018, introduced by the member for Mayo, and welcomed guests in the chamber ahead of a scheduled apology.
